Any '90s or '00s kid knows Selena and Justin basically consumed every brain cell we had throughout the entire 2010s. Theirdefined an era of pop culture, and let's be honest, despite them both finding their happy endings with their spouses — some people online are still curious if they'll find their way back to each other someday.
It all started in 2009, when Disney darling Selena Gomez was introduced to Canadian pop sensation Justin Bieber . The pair insisted they were"just friends" for months , but by February 2011, they finallyyy made things official and instantly became one of Hollywood's biggest power couples.
They attended endless red carpets together, wrote songs that fans can't help but speculate are about each other, and were on-and-off for years, eventually calling it quits in the spring of 2018. Just a few months after their split, Justin rekindled his romance with Hailey Bieber, and they married later that year, much to the utter shock of many fans.appearance in 2009, when Hailey attended with her father, actor Stephen Baldwin.
Years later, after Justin's on-again, off-again relationship with Selena Gomez came to another end in 2014, rumours about Justin and Hailey's connection were being whispered. And by late 2015, the two were spotted on a vacation in St. Barts.
Then, after some time apart, Justin and Hailey reconnected in June 2018...just MONTHS after Justin and Selena Gomez's final breakup. The timing itself made it one of the biggest celebrity talking points of the year. Then...the pair quickly became inseparable, attending church together, spending time with each other's families, and making their relationship increasingly public. And just weeks after rekindling their romance, Justin proposed to Hailey during a trip to the Bahamas in July 2018.
The engagement sent shockwaves through the world...not only because it seemed quick, but also because it came after years of Justin's highly publicized breakup with Selena Gomez. Just months after announcing their engagement, the couple quietly tied the knot at a New York City courthouse in September 2018, before returning a year later for a lavish wedding celebration in South Carolina, surrounded by family and friends. Since then, they have welcomed a son named Jack Blues Bieber.

Dating rumours quickly flooded the internet, especially after Trudeau was spotted attending her concerts and the pair were seen enjoying casual outings together.
After months of teasing us, their relationship was finallyyy made social media official on December 6, 2025, when Katy Perry shared photos and videos from their trip to Japan on Instagram. And ever since then, they've been vocal on social media, supporting each other's careers, families, and personal lives. Honestly, it's a pairing we never knew we needed. And while it still breaks my brain a little, they look incredibly happy.
Before Ryan Reynolds was famously married to Blake Lively , he was in a relationship with Alanis Morissette. I know they're both Canadian, but their romance is such an iconic part of Canadian pop culture that I just had to include it. It all started whenat Drew Barrymore's 27th birthday party in 2002. Honestly, what a flex of a place to kick off a relationship.
By February 2003, they were already hitting the red carpet together and making their relationship veryyy official. In fact, by June 2004, the couple had gotten engaged and begun planning their wedding.
Then, two years after their engagement, the couple split in June 2006, only to briefly reunite before calling it quits for good. By February 2007, their relationship was officially over. And just, in April 2007, Ryan Reynolds quickly moved on, beginning to date Scarlett Johansson. And by September 2008, Scarlett and Ryan had even gotten married.
What do you think? Did you forget about any of these couples?
'Cause I know I did. And while we are talking about Canadian musicians, I need to know... Which breakup songs from these Canadian artists are still total bops? Let's discuss in the comments!
